title: RTT/Inside Substrate Clarity Schema
description: Defines clarity score and clarity envelope metadata for RTT/Inside enterprise identity substrates.

clarity_score.description: Spectral clarity score representing how well-defined the identity is within its substrate context.

clarity_envelope.description: The coherence boundary within which the clarity score is evaluated.

clarity_origin.description: Indicates which identity substrate layer produced or asserted the clarity metadata.

clarity_timestamp.description: Timestamp indicating when the clarity score was generated or last updated.
